predeclared_statement: Reporting-only scorecard reaggregation, predeclared 2026-11-10 before recalculation: no tuning, no re-selection, no refit, promotion rule and both verdicts unchanged; stored predictions only (naive/LightGBM gate reference folds, theta exploration folds, verification-locked recovered theta holdout rows); metric definitions fixed as documented; six verification gates must pass or the release stops.

metric_definitions.rel_mae: per-series MAE(model)/MAE(naive) on identical folds, macro-averaged; naive = 1.00
metric_definitions.mase: Hyndman-Koehler seasonal m=12; scale = mean|y_t - y_{t-12}| over the point-in-time training window (vintage as-of origin month-end + 45 days, observations <= training cutoff)
metric_definitions.signed_bias: per-series MPE (mean percentage error, pp) and pooled relative bias (pp)
metric_definitions.uncertainty: origin-block bootstrap, whole origins with multiplicity, B=2000, seed=42, percentile 2.5/97.5
metric_definitions.first_release: actual = target month's first published vintage value; stored actual = latest revision in archive

holdout.caveat: 8 origin blocks — bootstrap CIs here are coarse. LightGBM rows are previously observed (gate reference folds), not an untouched holdout result. Theta rows are the recovered, verification-locked single-run predictions.

gate_full.caveat: Full gate reference window (2017-10..2025-03, all previously observed folds). Includes the holdout origins in its average.

first_release.note: Same stored predictions; actuals replaced by first published vintage values. Final-vintage counterparts are the 'actual' blocks above.
